review.imagery: All 94 unique indexed source pages, three own website contacts, all 17 original tower and 13 villa native raster resources visually reviewed. Root reviewed ten complete original A–D unit sheets, four complete Chapter Two villa pages, all nine E/F drawings, three alternative-edition whole pages, two original regional maps and the original island master aerial. Brabus villa numerical labels and all nine E/F area tables were read at enlarged resolution. Twenty-eight original concepts retain explicit original-tower versus Chapter Two captions. Repeated aerial/crop and generic stock are excluded. Broker mirror provenance is explicit for the UK-hosted packs. Areas absent from original A–D sheets and alternative editions remain unavailable.
review.floorPlans: Every delivered whole source sheet, visible source title and available numerical schedule reviewed by root. Missing original areas remain explicit. Original source notices and level pairs preserved.
review.location: Original named project marker, whole developer regional diagram and all factsheet estimates reviewed. Published pin retains project-vicinity scope and original travel modes remain explicit.
review.provenance: Fresh 8 November ordinary GET receipts preserve URL, time, byte size and SHA256, including byte-identical linked aliases. Independent original resources, numerical arithmetic, whole-page bounds, delivered lossless pixels and browser verification required before completion. Existing researched text and protected identities preserved.
